mode.title: What to scrape
mode.description: Pick the surface you want. Modes marked (needs input) require a list below; the rest discover their own targets.
enumTitles: Product detail: barcode, brand, gallery (needs input)

searchKeywords.title: Keywords
searchKeywords.description: For 'search' and 'searchSuggestions'. Plain keywords ('susu uht') or pasted alfagift.id/find/... URLs.

categoryIds.title: Category IDs or URLs
categoryIds.description: For 'categoryProducts'. A 24-character category id, or a pasted alfagift.id/c/... URL. Run 'categoryTree' first to see what exists.

productIds.title: Product IDs or URLs
productIds.description: For 'productDetail'. A numeric productId, or a pasted alfagift.id/p/... URL. A SKU such as A13170001210 will NOT work -- Alfagift only accepts the numeric id.

brandIds.title: Brand IDs or URLs
brandIds.description: For 'brandProducts'. A numeric brandId, or a pasted alfagift.id/b/... URL. Run 'brandDirectory' first to find ids.

promotionIds.title: Promotion IDs or URLs
promotionIds.description: Optional for 'promoProducts'. Leave empty to discover every live campaign from the banner rail. Note this is the id from a banner's deep link (/promotion-products?id=...), NOT the banner's own id.

brandLetters.title: Brand letters
brandLetters.description: Optional for 'brandDirectory'. Defaults to A-Z. Letters C, F, G, V and W are broken in Alfagift's own brand index and return HTTP 500 whatever you do -- the run reports them as diagnostic rows.

targets.title: Targets (generic)
targets.description: A single list routed into whichever field the chosen mode needs. Handy when chaining this actor after another one.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Stop after this many dataset rows. 0 means no limit.

pageSize.title: Page size
pageSize.description: Rows per request. Alfagift enforces no cap, so the default of 1000 fits most whole categories and keyword result sets into a single request.

maxPagesPerTarget.title: Max pages per target
maxPagesPerTarget.description: Safety ceiling on how far to page one category, brand or keyword. Rarely reached at the default page size.

bannerLocation.title: Banner location
bannerLocation.description: For 'promoBanners' and 'promoProducts'. Only 'main_banner_new' is used by the live site; an unknown location returns an empty list rather than an error.

bannerLimit.title: Banner limit
bannerLimit.description: How many banners to pull from the rail before resolving promotions.

includePromoDetail.title: Include promo detail
includePromoDetail.description: For 'promoBanners': also fetch each campaign's detail page (title, artwork, SEO copy). Costs one extra request per banner.

requestDelaySecs.title: Delay between requests (seconds)
requestDelaySecs.description: Alfagift did not rate limit 20 back-to-back requests during testing, so this is deliberately small. Raise it if a long catalogue walk starts seeing HTTP 429.

maxRetries.title: Max retries
maxRetries.description: How many times to retry a request that fails with a transient error. A 401 is never retried -- it means the site's encryption key rotated and no number of retries will help.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: A full-category request can return several megabytes, so keep this generous.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Alfagift has no WAF and no IP gate, so this actor works without a proxy. A residential Indonesian address only buys rate-limit headroom on very large walks.
